handler_overrides.debounce_rationale: Digital diagnostic fault. 3-of-5 majority voting provides deterministic latency (100ms max) and auditor familiarity. ASIL C requires <1% false-positive.
handler_overrides.validation_approach: Unit test with injected bit flips. Integration test with hardware fault injection (CAN message corruption).

handler_overrides.debounce_rationale: Liveness counter is sampled every 50ms. If counter stuck for >= 50ms, detect watchdog failure. Time-based is natural for periodic heartbeat.
handler_overrides.validation_approach: Freeze HW counter in simulator; measure detection latency in HIL. Test with artificially delayed counter increments (near timeout boundary).

handler_overrides.debounce_rationale: Supply voltage is analog 0-5V. Hysteresis deadband (±0.2V around nominal) avoids oscillation near 5V. ASIL B: <1% false-positive in nominal noise (±0.1V).
handler_overrides.validation_approach: Ramp supply through 4.8-5.2V. Dither at 5.0V ±0.05V for 1min; verify output stable. Measure false-positive rate vs. noise injection.

handler_overrides.debounce_rationale: SW->HW analog command (0-5V). Fast task (10ms) permits small filter (2-of-3, 30ms max latency). Reduces control lag.
handler_overrides.validation_approach: Step input 0V->5V; measure control loop response time. Inject bit flip in CAN frame; verify single bit does not affect output.
